entries.condition: inside a measured started process's line whose row's why_not_measured is NOT_MEASURED_DISAGREE (its starts were measured differently): said of each field the row holds null, in place of could not be read or could not be compared, since the starts disagreed on it or none read it and the row does not say which; and of the started launcher's environment in its launcher check
basis: isolation row uid, same_uid_as_worker, shares_group_with_worker, own_pid_namespace, own_mount_namespace, own_net_namespace, cap_eff_zero, cap_prm_zero, cap_amb_zero, no_new_privs, platform_names_in_env (null)

entries.condition: printed in place of INTRO_SENTENCE as the lead of the isolation block when a row of the part is isolated_by declaration (intro_sentence)

printed in the served report's Appendix B as the lead of the isolation block, inside the disclosure block, when the disclosure record holds an isolation part (a mapping with rows) and isolation_lines gives a line, and no row of the part is isolated_by declaration (intro_sentence); a record stored without the part prints none

written at build time as why_not_measured of a started process's row whose starts gave a measured field differently or left it unread at one start and not another; printed as the tail of that row's line, and compared there to say a null field as not read as one value across its starts (APART)
basis: the notes of each start of the source (attaches)

entries.condition: inside a measured started process's line: the capability sets measured as held (cap_*_zero false), else the sets that could not be read (null; not read as one value across its starts where why_not_measured is NOT_MEASURED_DISAGREE), else that it held none of the three
basis: isolation row cap_eff_zero, cap_prm_zero, cap_amb_zero, why_not_measured

entries.condition: one line per isolation row placed child (a stdio server the worker started): where measured_by is not worker, that it read the sample in a started process, with why_not_measured, and that its isolation cannot be told; otherwise each check as held, failed or unread (a null field of a row whose starts were measured differently said not read as one value across its starts), how many starts it was measured at, the tree sentence (with or without a declared launcher), the verdict (isolated, isolated by its block's declaration, not isolated), whether its block declares it needs the network, and why_not_measured where set
basis: isolation row measured_by, attaches, uid, same_uid_as_worker, shares_group_with_worker, own_pid_namespace, own_mount_namespace, own_net_namespace, cap_eff_zero, cap_prm_zero, cap_amb_zero, no_new_privs, platform_names_in_env
isolation row isolated, isolated_by, needs_network, launcher_depth, why_not_measured

entries.condition: inside a measured started process's line: that its environment could not be read (null; not read as one value across its starts where the row's starts were measured differently), held none of the platform's own variables (empty), or held the ones named
one line per isolation row placed in_process (a source the platform declares in-process, or a read the worker noted in itself): that it read the sample in the worker process and is not isolated

inside a started process's line whose block declares a launcher (launcher_depth above 0): the declaration of the top level or levels, the started process's own launcher check (_started_check), then that the descendants were not judged (with why), that no process under the launcher was measured, or how many under it were measured and, over every process the walk found below the started one (launcher levels included, summed over its starts where it had more than one), how many did not pass the check each is held to; each count named by its own set
basis: isolation row launcher_depth, descendants_judged, descendants_why, under_launcher, descendants, descendants_failing, attaches, platform_names_in_env

entries.condition: one line per isolation row placed at a local address, outside this machine or nowhere: the transport (or that none was recorded), the host where recorded, why it was not measured, and that it is not verified by this run, that this run cannot tell its isolation, or that its isolation cannot be told
basis: isolation row where, source, transport, host, why_not_measured

entries.condition: inside a started process's line whose block declares a launcher, after the declaration: the process the worker started, judged apart from its tree, passed its launcher check (platform_names_in_env empty), could not be checked (null; not read as one value across its starts where why_not_measured is NOT_MEASURED_DISAGREE), or did not pass it (names held)

inside a started process's line with no declared launcher: that its descendants were not judged (with why), that it had none when measured, or how many were measured and how many did not pass every check
basis: isolation row descendants_judged, descendants_why, descendants, descendants_failing

entries.condition: inside a measured started process's line: its user id, or that it could not be read (null), and whether one of its four user ids is the worker's, none is, or they could not all be read; where the row's starts were measured differently a null value is said not read as one value across its starts

names the source at the head of each in-process, started-process and service line, and in the headline over rows isolated by a declaration: an in-process source by its label and key (or as the in-process source), a tool server by its key, a provider's tool server by its key, any other by the source

printed second in the isolation block when the part holds a worker record and at least one row: the worker's user (or that it could not be read, with the reason where facts are unavailable) and whether its environment holds the platform's own variables

the isolation block of the served report's Appendix B, inside the disclosure block, for a disclosure record whose isolation part holds rows: a headline (no read recorded; every source kept as measured; kept but resting on a declared launcher for the sources named; not every source kept, where a row not isolated read in the worker or had its started process measured with a check read and not held (a launcher held only to its environment); else not every source shown to be kept, each listed with what was measured or why it was not), the worker line where there are rows, one line per row by where it read, one line for the reads with no source, then the sample integrity and sandbox target lines; [] for a record without the part
basis: disclosure.isolation rows, unsourced_reads, isolated, isolated_by, worker
isolation row where, measured_by, launcher_depth, needs_network and each measured check field
